Then R-LIT-55 does not fire

  Scenario: AC11 Error answers 401, 403 and 404 of the provided operations

    Given a role without the Litigation right of the operation
    When the operation is called

    Given no legal action exists for "LA-2026-000820"
    When the operation is called

  Scenario: AC12 Replay of a write with the same idempotency key
    Given the decision of AC1 was recorded for case "RC-2026-000820" under an idempotency key
    When the same write is replayed with the same idempotency key
    Then the operation answers with the result of the first write
    Then nothing is written a second time
